newsitem.title: UK: Security alert closes motorway, railway stations.
newsitem.headline: Security alert closes motorway, railway stations.

text.p: Police closed part of the M6 motorway and three railway stations in northwest England in security alerts on Friday morning, the BBC reported.

The BBC said Stoke-on-Trent, Doncaster and Crewe railway stations were all evacuated. Police had received a recognised coded warning in the Doncaster alert. The warning wsa telephoned to a local company.
Last month, two bombs exploded near Wilmslow railway station in northwest England, but no-one was injured. The Irish Republican Army claimed responsibilty for the attacks.
